# Maintenance helper provenance and scope

The Markdown checker, its original tests, dependency pins and MIT notice are
adapted from qpathformer/.github at commit
`f9d8d58501d40a3f1454777a89545191f2c1acb1`, in turn adapted from
[Access-PoD/access-pod-v1.0](https://github.com/Access-PoD/access-pod-v1.0/tree/74539b1259b49eefdf710be4d91ad127abd1b76a)
at commit `74539b1259b49eefdf710be4d91ad127abd1b76a`.

The original copyright and MIT notice are retained in LICENSE. Research
repository adaptations add an explicit current-document selection and a
current content-identity verifier with failure-case tests. Helpers, tests and
configuration in this directory use that scoped MIT notice. Parser packages
retain their own notices. This does not license Q-Pathformer research code,
papers, datasets, models, marks or other project content as MIT.

The source selection excludes archived study/package READMEs whose original
paths belong to their own distributions. Their bytes and notices remain
unchanged. Selected live documents can still link to tracked historical files.
